subject.title: [Bug]: TTS elevenlabs provider generates audio but OpenClaw plays OpenAI voice instead

question: Should configured TTS providers stay best-effort with automatic fallback, or should OpenClaw add a strict provider-stickiness/fail-closed mode for users who never want fallback speech?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally treat other configured TTS providers as fallbacks, while the remaining request would change user-visible provider-routing semantics and likely add config surface.

options.title: Preserve automatic fallback by default
options.body: Keep the current default behavior, require live proof for any successful-audio-discard bug, and improve only diagnostics or targeted provider failures as needed.

options.title: Add opt-in strict TTS mode
options.body: Expose a narrow documented setting so users can choose no fallback without breaking existing fallback users by default.

options.title: Make stickiness unconditional
options.body: Stop on configured-provider failure instead of falling back, accepting an upgrade-sensitive behavior change for users who currently depend on fallback speech.

recommendation.title: Preserve automatic fallback by default
recommendation.body: Keep the current default behavior, require live proof for any successful-audio-discard bug, and improve only diagnostics or targeted provider failures as needed.

likelyOwner.reason: The current fallback loop and recent TTS/provider routing work point to steipete as the best available owner for the product-direction choice.
